falsifiable_hypothesis: The current verified B branch benefits strongly from paid-value and standard-control calibration, while the A branch remains the dominant error source. Full replacement by an A-specific calibrator regressed, suggesting that its signal is useful only as a conservative auxiliary residual correction. The fixed K=3 inner-fold structure supplies a natural 1/K deployment strength.
A_auxiliary_training_rule: Within each outer-training partition use the authenticated bandwidth-0.7 inner OOF orientation-A predictions as the residual target. Rebuild orientation-A paid features from fitting-only plans. Cross-fit the verified global mean/std/min/max correction and min/max cardinality contrast, then cross-fit shared/two-dose/three-dose local models with LOCAL_STRENGTH=2*PRIOR=0.25. On the remaining matrix cross-fit the [mean_range,half_plate_difference,mean_range_squared] standard-control common ridge. Fit one rank-1 multioutput ridge to the post-common residual matrix using the same control basis, ridge lambda=PRIOR times mean patient-weighted feature energy, and no target-specific intercept.
A_auxiliary_deployment_rule: The full auxiliary correction is C_global + LOCAL_STRENGTH*C_local + C_control_common + (1/K)*C_rank1. Add exactly (1/K) times that full auxiliary correction to the already verified orientation-A prediction, with K=3. Thus the nested rank-1 sublayer contributes 1/K^2 overall. Orientation B is copied unchanged from control_rank1_target_deviation.
